description: This file contains a collection of functions for retrieving and manipulating MAC addresses across various hardware interfaces and storage types, primarily used in embedded Linux environments such as OpenWrt. It includes methods for reading MAC addresses from device trees, JSON configuration, mtd partitions, MMC devices, and more.

methods.name: get_mac_binary
methods.description: Reads a MAC address in binary form from a specified device or file at a given offset.

methods.name: get_mac_label_dt
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address from the device tree labels.

methods.name: get_mac_label_json
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address from a JSON configuration file.

methods.name: get_mac_label
methods.description: Attempts to get the MAC address from device tree, falling back to JSON configuration.

methods.name: find_mtd_chardev
methods.description: Finds the character device path for an MTD partition.

methods.name: get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Extracts and canonicalizes a MAC address from a partition or device.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Gets MAC address in ASCII format from an MTD partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_encrypted_arcadyan
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address encrypted in an Arcadyan partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_encrypted_deco
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address encrypted via Deco-specific method.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_uci_config_ubi
methods.description: Gets MAC address from UCI configuration within a UBI volume.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_text
methods.description: Reads MAC address as text from a partition at a specific offset.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_binary
methods.description: Reads MAC address in binary from an MTD partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_binary_ubi
methods.description: Reads MAC in binary from a UBI volume.

methods.name: mmc_get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Reads MAC in ASCII format from an MMC partition.

methods.name: mmc_get_mac_binary
methods.description: Reads MAC in binary format from an MMC partition.

methods.name: macaddr_add
methods.description: Adds a value to the NIC part of a MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_generate_from_mmc_cid
methods.description: Generates a MAC address based on the CID of an MMC device.

methods.name: macaddr_geteui
methods.description: Formats MAC address as EUI string.

methods.name: macaddr_setbit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_unsetbit
methods.description: Unsets a specific bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_random
methods.description: Generates a random MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_2bin
methods.description: Converts MAC address string to binary data.

methods.name: macaddr_canonicalize
methods.description: Normalizes various MAC address formats to a standard form.

methods.name: dt_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a device tree node is enabled.
